findings.target: scripts/run-htmldom-browser-test.sh: PORT=${CNA_HTMLDOM_TEST_PORT:-8731}; 'python3 -m http.server $PORT --directory $BUILD_DIR --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &' (output discarded, bind failure invisible); readiness is 'for _ in $(seq 1 50); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/$PAGE && break; sleep 0.1; done' (SERVER_PID is never checked and the loop falls through to the browser step after 5 s even if nothing answered); scripts/run-htmldom-test-suite.sh runs the six pages sequentially with PORTS smoke=8731 ... memory=8736. Ports are per PAGE, so two concurrent invocations of the same suite (or a stale server from a killed run) both use 8731 for the first page; the second server fails to bind silently and the curl poll is satisfied by the other process, so the driver can load a page served from a different build directory.
